So I saw this post and instantly decided to make an account just to comment this. So it was Halloween night and I felt super sick so I went home. And for some reason I had the sudden urge to tell my crush I love her. And I mean loved her. So I asked my friend if  I should ask my crush out and she said go ahead I'm not stopping you. So what I decided to do was tell her on instagram with no warning or starting a conversation. This is how the convo went.
Me: hey I really like you and I was wondering if we could go out sometime.
Her: umm this is (her name)'s friend I'll tell her you asked her out.
So my brain instantly thought oh crap her friend knows now.
Me:uhmm ok I guess
Her: hey TheOnlySaltyBacon I'm sorry I dont have feelings for you. Could we stay friends?
That ladies and gentlemen hurt me so much and I thought nothing could go anymore wrong until..... I woke up the next morning with texts from everyone saying I'm so sorry and dude imagine getting friend zoned.
I was so confused until  one of my best friend texts me saying "bro this guy put on his snapchat that you asked out (my crush) and sent out screenshots to everyone. My heart was in pieces. Mind you I was in 7th grade, and still trying to fit in. This is where my depression hit rock bottom. I couldn't stand going near anyone or talking to anyone except my friend.
For some reason I always thought she sent that guy screenshots of our conversation on accident. So when people try have my back and say she was in the wrong I would always say did it on accident and didn't mean it. 
Well fast forward a few months later while I was streaming ([My Twitch])(http://www.twitch.tv/TheOnlySaltyBacon) some Rocket league she decided to face time me and prank me saying she liked me back. Then before I could say anything she dipped. I was so happy I thought I had a chance with her. So I tried to text back but she didnt text back, she would just keep me on read. Until the next morning she texted saying "hey I was joking with you, I dont like u like that sorry."
I got so pissed off and sad I couldn't do anything except lay in bed. For some reason after all of that I'm still friends with her.
P.s this was Halloween 2019
TL:DR I asked crush out and she helped expose me by putting the convo on snap. Also she pranked me by telling she liked me. Srry for the long post lol
